title: competition_ranks algorithm ported verbatim into client demo_store instead of the shared/ package both importers already use
detail: A ~40-line tie-handling algorithm is duplicated across packages with sync enforced only by a comment. If the server's rank semantics change (ties, NULLS handling), the demo silently diverges — the exact demo-vs-real drift class this polish series fixes.
recommended_fix: Move competition_ranks/do_competition_ranks into shared/src/shared/leaderboard.gleam (pure, stdlib-only); import from application_list_handler and demo_store so one implementation feeds both.

title: Demo analysis payload strings now duplicated verbatim between client fixtures and server prebake for all 8 applicants
detail: This diff extends the established hand-sync convention to flags/positives (~50 lines of JSON literals per side). Drift means on-screen app-detail flags silently differ from the downloaded PDF — no test fails. Acceptable under current package layout, but the volume just crossed a threshold.
recommended_fix: Longer term, host the shared demo-analysis payloads (flags/positives/insight/category scores per applicant) in shared/ so demo_store and pdf_prebake read one constant set; keeps the documented mirror contract from scaling by hand.

title: pdf_report_data hand-rebuilds the contract_v4 extras JSON shape; verification_summary emits 4 of the encoder's 7 keys
evidence:
server/src/demo/pdf_report_data.gleam:145-156:
      #(
        "verification_summary",
        json.object([
          #("documents_processed", json.int(docs_processed)),
          #("documents_failed", json.int(0)),
          #("checks_unavailable", json.array(parts.checks, of: json.string)),
          #(
            "low_confidence_areas",
            json.array(parts.low_confidence, of: json.string),
          ),
        ]),
      ),

server/src/ai/contract_v4.gleam:563-576 (the real encoder the demo shape mirrors):
fn encode_verification_summary(s: VerificationSummary) -> json.Json {
  json.object([
    #("checks_performed", json.array(s.checks_performed, of: json.string)),
    #("checks_unavailable", json.array(s.checks_unavailable, of: json.string)),
    #(
      "low_confidence_areas",
      json.array(s.low_confidence_areas, of: json.string),
    ),
    #("documents_processed", json.int(s.documents_processed)),
    #("documents_failed", json.int(s.documents_failed)),
    #("anonymization_confidence", json.string(s.anonymization_confidence)),
    #("anonymization_iterations", json.int(s.anonymization_iterations)),
  ])
}

The Typst template reads only the four demo keys (server/priv/templates/audit_report.typ:1161-1164: `let cu = vs.at("checks_unavailable", default: ())` / `let lc = vs.at("low_confidence_areas", default: ())` / `let dp = vs.at("documents_processed", default: 0)` / `let df = vs.at("documents_failed", default: 0)`), so no visible gap today.
detail: Extras-shape parity with the real pipeline is maintained by hand in demo code rather than by the shared builder (contract_v4.build_extras_payload, contract_v4.gleam:41-59, is pub and takes json.Json). Harmless today; a future template-rendered extras key would reach real reports but not demo PDFs.
recommended_fix: Assemble the final object through contract_v4.build_extras_payload (it already wraps exactly the five keys demo emits) and keep the demo sub-shapes feeding it, so the five-key contract has one definition.
